title: Extremum Seeking Control
text: 通过最大化目标函数实时计算控制器参数，输入 1 路、输出 2 路；按 {Forcing frequency omega (rad/s)} 指定强制频率；{Time Domain} 指定滤波器和积分器时间域 Continuous、{Sample time} 指定离散时间滤波器和积分器采样时间、{Integrator method} 指定离散时间积分方法 Forward、{Number of parameters} 指定参数数量、{Initial condition x0} 指定初始参数值、{Learning rate k} 指定参数更新速率、{Demodulation amplitude a} 指定解调信号幅值、{Demodulation phase phi_1 (rad)} 指定解调信号相位、{Modulation amplitude b} 指定调制信号幅值、{Modulation phase phi_2 (rad)} 指定调制信号相位、{Enable HPF} 启用目标函数信号的高通滤波、{HPF frequency omega_h (rad/s)} 指定高通滤波器截止频率、{Enable LPF} 启用解调信号的低通滤波、{LPF frequency omega_l (rad/s)} 指定低通滤波器截止频率 ω l、{Output estimated parameters} 添加估计参数输出端口，按实例取值。

params.name: Time Domain
params.values: 滤波器和积分器时间域 Continuous time (default) | Discrete time

params.name: Sample time
params.values: 离散时间滤波器和积分器采样时间 0.1 (default) | finite positive scalar

params.name: Integrator method
params.values: 离散时间积分方法 Forward Euler (default) | Backward Euler | Trapezoidal

params.name: Number of parameters
params.values: 参数数量 1 (default) | positive integer less than or equal to 5

params.name: Initial condition x0
params.values: 初始参数值 0 (default) | finite scalar | vector

params.name: Forcing frequency omega (rad/s)
params.values: 强制频率 1 (default) | positive finite scalar | vector

params.name: Learning rate k
params.values: 参数更新速率 1 (default) | positive finite scalar | vector

params.name: Demodulation amplitude a
params.values: 解调信号幅值 1 (default) | positive finite scalar | vector

params.name: Demodulation phase phi_1 (rad)
params.values: 解调信号相位 0 (default) | positive finite scalar | vector

params.name: Modulation amplitude b
params.values: 调制信号幅值 0.1 (default) | positive finite scalar | vector

params.name: Modulation phase phi_2 (rad)
params.values: 调制信号相位 0 (default) | positive finite scalar | vector

params.name: Enable HPF
params.values: 启用目标函数信号的高通滤波 off (default) | on

params.name: HPF frequency omega_h (rad/s)
params.values: 高通滤波器截止频率 1 (default) | positive finite scalar | vector

params.name: Enable LPF
params.values: 启用解调信号的低通滤波 off (default) | on

params.name: LPF frequency omega_l (rad/s)
params.values: 低通滤波器截止频率 ω l 1 (default) | positive finite scalar | vector

params.name: Output estimated parameters
params.values: 添加估计参数输出端口 off (default) | on
